name: HKA Canonical End-to-End Pipeline

stages.exit_gate: canonical HKA World Tree source fixed by exact commit
all six canonical branches complete plus global coverage, prerequisite and semantic duplicate audits PASS
global academic lock commit exists; later stages reference it immutably
complete lesson records and website-target metadata authored from academic lock
global lesson prerequisite, coverage, age/path and duplicate audits PASS
all required visual descriptions and exact prompts authored only from locked lesson records
global semantic/visual duplicate audit and prompt integrity audit PASS
locked assets generated with stable Asset IDs and provenance
exact generated binaries stored create-only and checksum/read-back verified
exact staging binaries receive QA_APPROVED; rejected assets cannot progress
only QA_APPROVED exact binaries promoted and canonical release verified
web derivatives generated only from verified vault masters and quality checks PASS
approved optimized derivatives plus release metadata available to website
LESSON_ID mapping places delivery asset into correct program, age/path, lesson and website slot

recovery_rule: Every stage records durable checkpoint, accepted commit/object hashes, status and next_action. Any replacement window or worker reads those records and resumes; it never depends on chat history.
